@note: Magnetics add-on for PartCraft (0.8 SG.7+). English source.
name: Magnetics
intro: A flat (2-D) magnet study of a long device: a cross-section of iron, permanent magnets and coils in an air box. Solve it to read the flux density, the flux lines and the force on a body, show the result on the part, and save it. An analysis aid, not a design approval.
tpl.frame: Magnet in a closed iron frame
tpl.ccore.about: An iron C with an air gap in its front leg and a coil round its back leg. Checked against the magnetic circuit: B in the gap = μ0·NI / (gap + iron path / μr), no fringing.
tpl.frame.about: A permanent magnet in one leg of a closed iron frame. Checked against the magnetic circuit: B in the magnet = Br·(lm/μrm) / (lm/μrm + L/μr).
tpl.keeper.about: A U yoke with a magnet in its base and a keeper across the poles over a small gap; the force on the keeper is asked for. There is no hand formula, and a force through a thin gap is rough: run Normal and Fine and compare.
tpl.wire.about: One round conductor carrying a current. Checked against B = μ0·I / 2πr at twice its radius.
tpl.wires.about: Two long conductors with opposite currents push apart. Checked against F = μ0·I² / 2πd per metre; the air box edge acts as a wall, so this example uses a box four sizes wide.
tpl.name.coil_out: Coil, current out of the page
err.no_sketch: This part has no sketch. Draw the closed profiles of the bodies in sketches (touching bodies in different sketches), or use an example.
err.none_picked: Pick at least one sketch with closed profiles.
sketch.touching: Each closed profile is a body. Bodies that touch go in different sketches; all the sketches must lie on one plane.
note.planes: The sketches lie on different planes: the study treats them as one flat section, and the result is shown on the first one's plane.
note.face_plane: The sketch lies on a face or a reference plane: the result is shown on the front plane, at the sketch's own coordinates.
region.curve_note: Pairs of B (T) and H (A/m), one per line, both rising. With a curve the iron saturates; without one it is linear with the μr given. The numbers are yours: no data sheet ships.
box.note: Its edge holds the field in (A = 0 there), like a wall: give more air when the field reaches it.
msg.nothing_to_show: Nothing to show: tick at least one thing under On the part.
msg.placed: {n} display bodies placed on the part (one undo step).
msg.placed_skipped: {n} display bodies placed; left out to stay under the viewport's limit: {what}. Use the Normal mesh to show everything.
msg.cleared: The study's display bodies were taken off the part.
msg.none_placed: No study is shown on the part.
res.plot_alt: The flux density |B| over the section (the top color is the 99th percentile and more), with flux lines and the bodies' outlines
res.bmax: Largest |B| {B} T at x {x}, y {y} mm.
res.flux: {n} flux lines; {dA} flows between two neighboring lines over the depth of {d} mm.
res.force: Fx {fx} N, Fy {fy} N, torque {tau} N·m
res.depth_note: Forces are for a depth of {d} mm (the flat result per metre × the depth), from the Maxwell stress on a box round the body in air; torque is about the body's middle.
res.check_off: The result and the hand formula disagree by more than the example expects: give more air round the bodies, a finer mesh, or check the numbers.
hand.ccore: Gap field against the magnetic circuit:
hand.frame: Field in the magnet against the magnetic circuit:
hand.wire: Field at twice the radius against μ0·I / 2πr:
problem.saturation: The largest |B| is {B} T in iron with only a permeability: real iron saturates near 2 T, so give it a B–H curve.
problem.force_thin: The force on body {n} comes through a thin air gap and is rough: run Normal and Fine and compare.
part.note: The result is placed in the study's plane as display bodies: the bodies from the plane out to the depth, the field near them (half the model's size round it) on their far face. Display only: no mass, not in STL or STEP.
part.placed: {n} display bodies on the part. They are saved with the part; Undo takes them off.
group.name: Magnet study (largest |B| {B} T)
svg.legend: |B| from 0 (dark blue) to {B} T and more (red; the largest is {max} T); {dA} between neighboring flux lines.
limits: Limits: flat (2-D) sections of long devices only, no axisymmetric or 3-D; steady fields, no eddy currents or hysteresis; magnets on a straight recoil line (no demagnetization knee); iron linear unless you give a B–H curve; the force from the Maxwell stress depends on the mesh near the body (compare Normal and Fine). Every material number is yours or an example, not a data sheet. An analysis aid, not a design approval.
